subject: Bikes + Cars
author: Xandu
body:
From what I've read the host can somehow use a bike when the other people in the lobby are driving cars and the other way around. Apparently the host will be driving something that looks like a bike but really isn’t. Think of it as a car with a bike skin. Races are not possible like this because the glitch gets reset in a race. Freeburn games like stunt run and marked men are possible as long as the other players are driving cars.
I have no idea on how to actually do this.

-- The Creator --
